程序包 org.bukkit.util

类 EulerAngle

java.lang.Object
org.bukkit.util.EulerAngle
public class EulerAngle extends Object
EulerAngle is used to represent 3 angles, one for each axis (x, y, z). The angles are in radians EulerAngle 用于表示 3 个角度，每个轴（x、y、z）各一个。角度以弧度为单位
